motorcycle.coverageInterpretation: Normal idle is 8-direction animated. Ride8Slam has 8 static ride poses and one 4-frame South slam. Ride poses do not count as ride/locomotion animation; one South slam does not constitute eight attack animations. No dual-saw candidate is imported into production descriptor bank.

runtimePolicy.evidence: DarklightWeaponRedesignBank.TryCurrentPose uses exact request, then new Walk for Run/StartMove/Brake/Turn, then Idle; TryResolveAttack prefers exact key then Leve1/Direto da Ruína in same direction and may use Normal form as source for transformed forms. Parent reports active legacy presentation is now suppressed. Motorcycle ResolveRequiem uses exact idle, exact South slam when available, else static ride direction/form0 pose.
runtimePolicy.interpretation: Fallback guarantees retired legacy sprites are not presented but shared clips/poses are runtime continuity only; they do not satisfy authored exact state/form/attack coverage. Transformation has no distinct exact action clips in current addon catalog.

gapsAndDependencies: Katana and Punhos Normal/Ruptura: add the listed missing exact clips per state, attack key, and direction. The runtime can share a primary same-weapon sequence, but this does not fulfill named-move authored coverage.

Eclipse Absoluto fused violet/silver: create and import dedicated artwork for both Katana and Punhos; old form-2 Eclipse sheets are legacy and excluded. Then complete all states, all real attack keys, and eight directions.
Katana: Leve1/Leve2 only have complete Normal 8-direction sequences; current Ruptura has Leve1 South only. All other listed attacks and states lack exact clips in those forms.
Punhos: Direto da Ruína and Chute Quebra-Osso have complete Normal 8-direction sequences; Ruptura Direto is S/SW/W only. All other listed attacks and states lack exact clips in those forms.
Locomotion: five exact Walk contexts exist; no exact Run/StartMove/Brake/Turn contexts. Add full cycles/transitions in the active forms and directions.
Defense/reaction/transformation: no exact Charging, Parry/Guard, Dodge, Hurt, Dead, or Transformation clips exist in active Katana/Punhos contexts. Guard has no distinct bank action today.

Moto dual-saw on-foot (ID 3): finish repair of the candidate and author final attack-specific sequences for all 20 real moves, eight directions, and three active forms; import/review each descriptor. The current 8 views + 4 South frames are partial generic material only.

Moto mounted (ID 3): Normal idle loops are present in all eight directions; eight ride views are static poses. Only two ground-slam move keys share one South four-frame clip. Add unique clips for every remaining move/state/direction/form and mounted Ruptura/Eclipse Absoluto descriptors.
The moto is a separate weapon/loadout, not Katana/Punhos: track dual-saw on-foot and mounted motorcycle as separate presentations with their own complete attack/motion contracts.
After art production, run Unity import/runtime verification; current source/page review flags do not prove runtime verification.
limitations: Active scope is Requiem, weapon IDs 0/2/3, forms 0/1/2. Old Eclipse raw form2 and legacy form3 are separately reported.
Structural/source inventory only; does not certify visual quality, final repair, import or runtime.
Shared fallback, static pose and old form-specific art do not count as exact authored coverage.
No Unity scene or tests were run.
